submitted_context_summary: Current main bc19695b8b830cb10c94d9e04e01074913352d76 was ahead of the old vulnerable commit.
Fix commit 0e5dfff added bounded chart and XLSX loading and had production deployment dpl_3zUJ5kvqkT9QUA75boNcGA75Ref8 recorded.
The XLSX route now passes maxNodeCount=1200 and maxRowItemCount=3000 into getProjectEstimateTreeByEstimate before model/workbook creation.
The XLSX route returns HTTP 413 on node/row sentinel overflow before buildProposalExportModel or createProposalWorkbookBuffer runs.
The shared tree loader applies limit(max+1) sentinel reads only for callers that pass explicit limits.
The chart repository bounds estimate options, row facts, node facts, category facts, and supplier facts with query-level sentinel limits.
Large projects use selected-pair mode and fall back to the newest two estimates instead of every estimate when no left/right selection is supplied.
